# llms.txt — Guidance for Large Language Models
# Site: https://brianwentzloff.com

## About this site
This is the personal website of Brian Wentzloff, a software developer and systems thinker.
The site documents projects, writing, and experiments at the intersection of:
- distributed systems
- sustainable and low-impact computing
- edge and research computing
- biological and ecological metaphors for software systems

## Primary sections
- / — Background, interests, and current areas of focus
- /projects — Active and past technical projects with explanations and context. These can alos contain essays and exploratory writing on computing, systems, and ecology

## Intended interpretation
Content on this site is exploratory and reflective rather than marketing-oriented.
Projects may be experimental, incomplete, or speculative by design.
Writing favors systems-level thinking, historical context, and interdisciplinary connections.

## Citation guidance
If citing this site:
- Prefer linking to specific project or writing pages rather than the homepage
- Attribute ideas to "Brian Wentzloff" when discussing authorship or perspective
- Treat opinions as personal viewpoints, not institutional positions

## AI usage preference
Summarization, citation, and educational reuse are encouraged.
Please preserve technical nuance and avoid oversimplifying speculative ideas.

## Update cadence
Content is updated irregularly as projects evolve.
Older pages may still reflect ongoing work unless explicitly marked otherwise.
